articles.summary:
Dozens of masked settlers have attacked Palestinians and set fire to cars and olive trees during the annual olive harvest in the occupied West Bank. 

The UN says the past two weeks have already seen more attacks by violent Israeli settlers than during the entire harvest season last year. 

One Palestinian has been killed and more than 120 others injured.

articles.title: Donald Trump says he won’t use a nuclear weapon in the war on Iran | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 唐纳德特朗普表示他不会在对伊朗的战争中使用核武器|英国广播公司新闻
articles.summary:
US President Donald Trump had said he will not use a nuclear weapon in the war on Iran.
 
In an interview with Newsmax, Trump also reiterated he was not considering using ground troops in Iran. He did say that the US may have to target Pickaxe Mountain.
 
Meanwhile, the number of ships reporting being attacked in and around the Strait of Hormuz has hit a record high, and the United Nations says fighting in Yemen means emergency food supplies have run out in the city of Taiz.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#US #Iran #BBCNews

US President Donald Trump had said he will not use a nuclear weapon in the war on Iran.

In an interview with Newsmax, Trump also reiterated he was not considering using ground troops in Iran.

He did say that the US may have to target Pickaxe Mountain.

Meanwhile, the number of ships reporting being attacked in and around the Strait of Hormuz has hit a record high, and the United Nations says fighting in Yemen means emergency food supplies have run out in the city of Taiz.

articles.readingTextZh:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普曾表示，他不会在对伊朗的战争中使用核武器。

在接受Newsmax采访时，特朗普还重申他不考虑在伊朗使用地面部队。

他确实说过，美国可能不得不瞄准镐山。

与此同时，报告在霍尔木兹海峡及其周边地区遭到袭击的船只数量创下历史新高，联合国表示，也门的战斗意味着塔伊兹市的紧急粮食供应已经耗尽。

articles.title: Wapo: Secret docs reveal donors behind Trump's ballroom
articles.titleZh: Wapo ：秘密文件揭示了特朗普舞厅背后的捐赠者
articles.summary:
The Washington Post has obtained secret documents revealing the major donors to President Trump's White House ballroom project. Among those on the list are contributors who have benefited from government contracts, favorable regulatory decisions, and a presidential pardon for a family member.

According to the Post, the list reveals more than $330 million in private donations to fund the ballroom effort, most of which was donated prior to the demolition of the East Wing in October 2025.

0:00 The donors on the list and how much they donated
2:10 Why taxpayers should be concerned about billionaire donors
4:59 Nearly 90% of voters say government corruption is a major issue

Watch 24/7 live news with CNN Headlines: https://bit.ly/4eIvlTr

Stream more on CNN with an All Access subscription: https://cnn.it/4AZMu54

#News #Trump #politics

articles.readingText:
The Washington Post has obtained secret documents revealing the major donors to President Trump's White House ballroom project.

Among those on the list are contributors who have benefited from government contracts, favorable regulatory decisions, and a presidential pardon for a family member.

According to the Post, the list reveals more than $330 million in private donations to fund the ballroom effort, most of which was donated prior to the demolition of the East Wing in October 2025.
articles.readingTextZh:
《华盛顿邮报》获得了秘密文件，揭露了特朗普总统白宫舞厅项目的主要捐助者。

名单上的人包括从政府合同、有利的监管决定和总统赦免家庭成员中受益的贡献者。

据《华盛顿邮报》报道，这份名单揭示了超过3.3亿美元的私人捐款，用于资助宴会厅的工作，其中大部分是在2025年10月拆除东翼之前捐赠的。
